description: We are passionate about creative STEM education and space storytelling. For this challenge, we aim to bring NASA's forgotten lunar and Martian missions to life through an interactive, didactic experience. If you want to build a high-impact project and contribute with web development, digital art, UI/UX design, or historical research, join our team!
summary:
Celestial Odyssey is an interactive pixel-art web platform that turns the history of space hardware left behind on the Moon, Mars, and Earth orbit into an engaging educational adventure. Inspired by The Odyssey and EPIC: The Musical, our project invites children, youth, and the general public to embark on their own space odyssey alongside Winion, our guide character. Through an interactive planetary map, players discover historic probes, landers, rovers, and satellites—such as the Apollo, Luna, Surveyor, Viking, Pathfinder, and Vanguard missions—learning about their scientific purpose, reasons for abandonment, and current status.

To address the challenge of making complex aerospace history accessible and memorable, we combined visual storytelling, ambient audio, and a bilingual (English/Spanish) gamified progression system featuring XP, ranks, achievements, and unlockable skins inspired by the characters of EPIC: The Musical. This project matters because it preserves humanity’s space heritage, sparks STEM curiosity through familiar storytelling, and promotes space sustainability.
details:
Celestial Odyssey is an interactive, gamified web platform designed to explore the history of space hardware left behind on the Moon, Mars, and Earth orbit after completing their missions. The idea was inspired by The Odyssey and the cultural phenomenon EPIC: The Musical, a work that many children and young people know and enjoy today; just as Odysseus embarked on a great journey full of challenges and discoveries to return home, we wanted to invite users to live their own odyssey exploring space. Upon entering, players are greeted by Winion, our guide character, who accompanies them through an interactive star map where, by selecting the Moon, Mars, or Earth, they discover historic spacecraft, lunar modules, rovers, and satellites—such as the Apollo, Luna, Surveyor, Viking, Pathfinder, and Vanguard missions—displaying visual cards about their origin, scientific objective, reasons for abandonment, and current status. As they progress on their space journey, they earn experience points (XP), level up, unlock achievements, and obtain titles and skins inspired by the characters of EPIC: The Musical to customize their crew profile.

The project offers significant educational and science communication benefits by transforming complex aerospace records into a relatable, exciting narrative adventure for children, students, and the general public. With this, we aim to generate a twofold impact: sparking early interest in STEM fields and space exploration by connecting a story they are already passionate about with real science, and raising awareness about the technological legacy humanity leaves on other worlds, as well as the importance of sustainability and responsible management of objects that remain in space.

For the technical development of the platform, we used a modern stack based on Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to build a fast, responsive interface adaptable to both computers and mobile devices. For the backend, authentication, and data persistence, we implemented Firebase Authentication (supporting email and Google accounts) along with Cloud Firestore to synchronize in real time each user's exploration progress, experience points, level, achievements, unlocked skins, and language preference. Additionally, all visuals were created with original custom pixel-art illustrations for the characters, planets, space artifacts, and backgrounds, accompanied by a built-in ambient audio player and version control using Git and GitHub.

The creativity of our proposal lies in bridging the gap between musical theater culture and space science, turning what would normally be a technical encyclopedia into a retro RPG-style video game inspired by a musical epic. During the design process, our team considered key factors such as linguistic inclusion—integrating full bilingual support in English and Spanish with instant switching across the entire interface—, balancing the historical accuracy of space missions with an engaging narrative language for younger generations, and intuitive usability so that any player can explore and feel motivated to complete their entire galactic odyssey.
